A consumer that finds any bound blob hash to differ from the value re-derived by `git ls-tree` at read time MUST NOT apply this ratification to whatever the differing content is now. CANDIDATE_BINDING.candidate_sha_re_derivation_note: This is the commit whose tree the six effective_package blob hashes below were read FROM (`git ls-tree -r d21f9f18a26197d288542035bdb49f65b17d1203 -- <paths>`, re-run at materialization). It is recorded for provenance; STOP_RATIFICATION_BINDING_MISMATCH is triggered by a BLOB HASH mismatch on any of the six paths, not by the candidate SHA alone becoming an ancestor of a later commit.
CANDIDATE_BINDING.STOP_RATIFICATION_BINDING_MISMATCH: Triggered when a re-derivation of any blob_sha above, at the time this record is consumed, does not match the value recorded here. When triggered: this record does not apply to the differing artifact; the owner's selections remain their selections as a matter of record, but their binding to a SPECIFIC effective package is broken, and a successor ratification record (or a re-confirmation from the owner against the new candidate) is required before any execution DAG may cite OD-1..OD-6 as settled.
